sql_query:
SELECT scrobbles.artist,
       COUNT(*) AS scrobble_count
FROM `netdev-firebase.barogroove_analytics.scrobbles` AS scrobbles
WHERE scrobbles.artist IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY scrobbles.artist
ORDER BY scrobble_count DESC
LIMIT 8
